items.text: **Welcome to the great Copilot Chat journey: Use case of the week!**

Get ready to unlock the full potential of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat!

 This week we're starting on a journey that's all about putting Copilot Chat into practice.
Every Wednesday for the next four weeks we will show you **how Copilot Chat can help with everyday tasks like drafting, organising information, analysing content, or planning next steps.
No theory - just practical examples you can try immediately and see the difference in your daily work.**

Stay tuned as we build new Copilot habits, week by week!

body.text:
**SCENARIO DESCRIPTION**

This use case demonstrates how to **leverage Copilot Chat to extract key information from a document and transform it into a professional LinkedIn post**.

The process begins by **uploading a document** to OneDrive and **prompting Copilot to extract** five key highlights.

We then **dive deeper** into one of the points, enrich the content with real-time web updates, and **generate a bilingual** (English and Italian) LinkedIn post tailored for Mobility Managers. The post includes **relevant hashtags** and a **suggested publishing time**.

Finally, we **collaborate with a colleague** by sharing the content via Microsoft 365 tools, enabling **real-time co-editing**.

This scenario showcases how Copilot Chat enhances productivity, creativity, and teamwork in content creation.

**PROMPTS USED**

items.text: [✨ *Extract information from this document, I need 5 key points to prepare the text of a post for LinkedIn.*]
[✨ *Check if there are any updates on these topics by searching the web.*]
[✨ *Integrate this information into the LinkedIn post, write the text in the first person, maximum length of 200 words, in English and Italian.*]
